questions.text:
Consider the following databases chedule with two transactions, T1 and T2.
[latex]S=r_{2}(X);r_{1}(X);r_{2}(Y);w_{1}(X);r_{1}(Y);w_{2}(X);a_{1};a_{2}[/latex]
where [latex]r_{i}(Z)[/latex] denotes a read operation by transaction [latex]T_{i}[/latex] on avariable Z, [latex]w_{i}(Z)[/latex] denotes a write operation by [latex]T_{i}[/latex] on avariable Z and [latex]a_{i}[/latex] denotes an abort by transaction [latex]T_{i}[/latex].
Which one of the following statements about the above schedule is TRUE?
questions.solution:
No transaction reads a value written by the other before it ends: T1 reads X before T2 writes it, and T2's reads happen before T1's write. So when T1 aborts, T2 does not need to be aborted: no cascading abort.

It is not strict, because [latex]w_2(X)[/latex] overwrites [latex]w_1(X)[/latex] while T1 is still active.

Answer: S does not have a cascading abort

questions.text: A network has a data transmission bandwidth of [latex]20 \times 10^{6}[/latex] bits per second. It uses CSMA/CD in the MAClayer. The maximum signal propagation time from one node to another node is 40 microseconds. The minimum size of a frame in the network is  ______ bytes.
questions.solution:
For CSMA/CD the frame must still be sending when news of a collision returns: [latex]T_t\ge2T_p[/latex].

Min frame = [latex]2\times40\times10^{-6}\times20\times10^6=1600[/latex] bits = 200 bytes

Answer: 200

questions.text:
For the IEEE802.11 MAC protocol for wireless communication,which of the following statements is/are TRUE?
I. At least three non-overlapping channels are available for transmissions.
II. The RTS-CTS mechan is misused for collision detection.
III. Unicast frames are ACKed.
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- I: 802.11 (2.4 GHz) has 3 non-overlapping channels (1, 6, 11) True
- II: RTS/CTS is for collision avoidance (hidden terminals); wireless stations cannot detect collisions False
- III: unicast frames are acknowledged True

Answer: I and III only

questions.text: Consider a [latex]128 \times 10^{3}[/latex] bits/second satellite communication link with one way propagation delay of 150 milliseconds. Selective retransmission(repeat) protocol is used on this link to send data with a frame size of 1 kilobyte. Neglect the transmission time of acknowledgement. The minimum number of bits required for the sequence number field to achieve 100% utilization is ________.
questions.solution:
Frame = 1 KB = 8192 bits [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [latex]T_t=\frac{8192}{128000}=64[/latex] ms. RTT = 300 ms.
For 100% utilization the window must cover [latex]\frac{64+300}{64}\approx5.7[/latex] [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 6 frames.

Selective repeat needs window [latex]\le2^{k-1}[/latex]: [latex]2^{k-1}\ge6\Rightarrow k=4[/latex].

Answer: 4
